_comment: Neptune Paper Trading Configuration — OC-CLIENT-001 — $212M fund scale

order_limits.comment: Scaled for $212M fund. Range $100K-$250K = ~0.05%-0.12% of portfolio.

position_limits.comment: Equities max 10%, ETFs max 15% of total portfolio value. A BUY is rejected if the ticker is already at/over its limit or the trade would push it over. SELLs are never blocked. max_single_position_pct is the legacy key, used only as the equity fallback.

cash_limits.comment: Cash must not drop below 5% of total portfolio after any buy

sector_limits.comment: No single sector may exceed 25% of total equity holdings (~$26M at current scale)

restricted_tickers.reason: CRITICAL legal risk — Nasdaq deficiency, restatement, securities class action
restricted_tickers.comment: Neptune auto-rejects any order involving these tickers

etf_proxies.comment: Mercury may only submit orders for these ETF tickers

soft_criteria.comment: Soft criteria produce warnings but Neptune may still approve with rationale

pipeline_data_paths.comment: Paths on Jetson — adjust for Shogun (/home/shogun/) or Mac Mini

local_copies.comment: Local copies synced by sync_pipeline_data.sh before each run
